contexts.text: To Potiphar the chamberlain of Pharaoh () = the interior things of scientifics. Chamberlain = interior things... for the chamberlains were connected with the interior affairs of the king, being the more interior stewards and more eminent governors. The signification is also evident from the meaning of the word in the Original Tongue.

Potiphar the chamberlain of Pharaoh bought him () = that he was with the interior things of scientifics. The chamberlain of Pharaoh = the interior things of scientifics. The interior things of scientifics are those which approach more nearly to spiritual things, and are applications of scientifics to celestial things...
